_comment: Gear model -> content set, for `xi mv update --only gear-sets`.
Keys are normalised item names: lower case, punctuation stripped, spaces as _.
Every name here was checked twice: it must exist in the server's item_basic
table (name OR sortname - mythics are stored as conqueror_85 with sortname
conqueror), and it must match a label already present in characters.json.
Names that failed either check were dropped, which is how a fabricated
wiki-scrape of 100+ nonexistent 'Limbus' items was caught and discarded.
Limbus was tried (Homam/Nashira, enumerated from item_basic by family) and
withdrawn - see retiredSets. Only two of its families have models on this
install, so the bucket read as an arbitrary ten pieces rather than a set.
Omen is deliberately absent: its scales upgrade Artifact/Relic/Empyrean +2
to +3, so its armour IS those models, and all 29 of its unique rewards are
accessories with no gear model (0 matched characters.json).
_labelFixesComment: Hand corrections for mistyped rows in the curated list, keyed by the row's
current label, lower-cased. Both are Futhark (RUN Relic) pieces:
- 'Futhark Coat (RUN AF@)' — the other six Futhark Coat rows read (RUN Relic).
- 'Futhark Mitons (GEO Relic)' — GEO's relic is Bagua; its six siblings read RUN.
Applied by the gear-labels target, and idempotent: once a row is corrected its
old label no longer matches the key.
_sectionsComment: Copied verbatim into characters.json as `gearSections` so the viewer reads
its section order and its catch-all rule from the data instead of hard-coding
them. Add a set to `byName` and list it in `order` and it shows up; a set the
viewer meets that is not in `order` still shows, sorted, after the listed ones.
`other` folds the leftovers on weapon slots into one bucket at the bottom:
`groups` are group values from the list itself, and `includeUngrouped` sweeps
up the rows with no group (the ones that would otherwise read as 'Standard').
Armour slots are not listed, so they keep their large plain 'Standard' run.
_retiredSetsComment: Sets that were tagged once and have since been withdrawn. The gear-sets
target clears them from any row that still carries one, so those pieces
fall back into the plain 'Standard' run. Kept here rather than deleted so
a stale list still converges on the next run.
